title: crataegus polyacantha subsp. heldreichii
intro: Crataegus polyacantha subsp. heldreichii, commonly known as the Western hawthorn, is a type of hawthorn plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus polyacantha subsp. heldreichii include vasodilation, reducing inflammation, and improving lipid profiles. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin and epicatechin, as well as oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which contribute to its medicinal properties.
